tokens.name: color-canvas
tokens.usage: App background behind panels; also the field fill of inputs and command blocks.

tokens.name: color-panel
tokens.usage: Chrome surfaces: title bar, sidebar, task header, tabs, inspector, status bar, board tiles, dialogs.

tokens.name: color-raised
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, segmented control track, search field, selected task row, toasts.

tokens.name: color-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, ghost and icon buttons; selected segment fill.

tokens.name: color-press
tokens.usage: Pressed fill for secondary buttons.

tokens.name: color-line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panels and sections, and the edge of secondary buttons (their fill and label already identify them). Decorative only.

tokens.name: color-line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that must be seen: input and select borders, toggle track when off, checkbox, kbd, dialog edge. 3:1 or more on panel, canvas and raised in every theme.

tokens.name: color-text
tokens.usage: Primary text and titles on canvas, panel, raised and hover. 12:1 or more in every theme.

tokens.name: color-text-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ghost buttons, notes, inspector headings, icons in the chrome. 6.5:1 or more on every surface in every theme.

tokens.name: color-text-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: metadata, ages, group labels, placeholders, hints. 4.8:1 or more on every surface in every theme; the lightest text Brachio uses.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Theme accent fill: primary button, toggle on, selected theme swatch ring, progress. Changes with the color theme (Mint, Lilac, Sand, Contrast). Never used as text.

tokens.name: color-accent-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on color-accent. 4.5:1 or more in every theme (Mint 10.4:1).

tokens.name: color-accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, selected tab underline and accent text on panel and canvas. 4.5:1 or more on panel, canvas and raised in every theme.

tokens.name: color-focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring, offset 2px, on every focusable control. 3:1 or more on every surface. Contrast themes use yellow or blue so focus never looks like a selected fill.

tokens.name: color-mint
tokens.usage: Brand mint. The mascot and the app icon only. Fixed in every theme; the UI accent is color-accent.

tokens.name: color-mint-ink
tokens.usage: Text on brand mint (the cover and marketing only), 10.4:1.

tokens.name: color-brand-charcoal
tokens.usage: App icon squircle and the mascot's eyes. Not a UI surface.

tokens.name: color-status-working
tokens.usage: Working: spinning arc glyph and its label. Always with the glyph and a word. 4.5:1 or more on every surface in every theme.

tokens.name: color-status-blocked
tokens.usage: Needs you: filled diamond, the Needs you group label, the approval bar edge, the count badge fill. 4.5:1 or more on every surface in every theme.

tokens.name: color-status-ready
tokens.usage: Ready for review: hollow ring glyph and label; QA passed. Kept green in every color theme so status reads the same everywhere. 4.5:1 or more on every surface in every theme.

tokens.name: color-status-error
tokens.usage: Error or crashed: filled square with an x, error notes. Red appears only for errors and danger. 4.5:1 or more on every surface in every theme.

tokens.name: color-status-neutral
tokens.usage: Done (check circle) and Unknown (dashed ring). 4.5:1 or more on every surface in every theme.

tokens.name: color-add
tokens.usage: Added lines and +N in diff stats.

tokens.name: color-del
tokens.usage: Removed lines and -N in diff stats.

tokens.name: color-add-bg
tokens.usage: Row tint behind added lines in the diff view.

tokens.name: color-del-bg
tokens.usage: Row tint behind removed lines in the diff view.

tokens.name: color-blocked-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind the approval bar header row and the Needs you notice. Never behind text that is not blocked-related.

tokens.name: color-error-bg
tokens.usage: Tint behind a terminal error notice (lost connection, could not start). Always with the error glyph and a sentence.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Fill of destructive buttons (Delete, Forget and reopen anyway, Sign out of Codex).

tokens.name: color-danger-ink
tokens.usage: Text on color-danger. 4.5:1 or more in every theme.

tokens.name: color-badge-ink
tokens.usage: Digits on the amber count badge. 4.5:1 or more in every theme.

tokens.name: color-term-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal pane, selected tab and board tile preview background.

tokens.name: color-term-text
tokens.usage: Default terminal foreground and tile preview text (12:1 or more).

tokens.name: color-scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs and the new task sheet.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog titles, empty state titles, settings page titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Add rate limit to the login endpoint
styles.usage: Task header title, board heading, section heads.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Claude Code wants to run a command in this worktree.
styles.usage: App base size. Task titles in the list (500), tile titles (600), running text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, segmented control, status labels, inputs.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Agents ask before running commands outside the worktree.
styles.usage: Hints, notes, status bar. The smallest size anywhere in the UI.

styles.name: group-label
styles.usage: Sidebar group heads and inspector section heads.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Branches, ages, diff stats, counts, kbd.

styles.name: terminal
styles.usage: Terminal (xterm.js), command blocks in the approval bar, tile previews.

spacing.note: A 4px base. Fixed chrome rhythm uses 14px and 18px side insets, written out in components.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to text in dense rows, group head bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside rows, small button padding, task row vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button side padding, board gap, approval padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Board padding, sidebar empty state padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps in settings and dialogs.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between settings sections and board columns' top inset.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Empty state padding.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Kbd, agent chip.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon buttons, command block.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Board tiles, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the new task sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Only on layers above the app: dialogs, toasts, menus, the quick open palette. Panels never cast shadows.

size.note: Fixed chrome sizes. Hit targets are 24px minimum and 28px by default (desktop, pointer first).

tokens.name: size-titlebar
tokens.usage: Title bar height.

tokens.name: size-statusbar
tokens.usage: Status bar height.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Default control height: buttons, icon buttons, inputs in the chrome, search.

tokens.name: size-tabs
tokens.usage: Terminal tab strip height.

tokens.name: size-task-header
tokens.usage: Task header (title line plus branch line).

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Task list width.

tokens.name: size-inspector
tokens.usage: Inspector width.

tokens.name: size-inspector-wide
tokens.usage: Inspector width while a diff is open side by side (Changes). The person can drag between 320px and 50% of the window.

tokens.name: size-dialog
tokens.usage: Width of confirm dialogs and the report form. New task is 560px, settings 760px, quick open 640px.
